_readme: FIAT ROOM BANDS (10 Oct, concept - docs/design/faces_and_bands.md section 4): Training (the_caravan), the Workshop, the Radio, the Yard and Stats, 688x296, art/places/<slug>.png, shown covering the band from the centre and shaded from the left, as the Clinic's and the Fence's.
Style image: art/places/ransacked_streets.png, as the places manifest. A job whose file exists is skipped.
Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_rooms_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <slug> ++ --force).

jobs._where: Training's band (110 px high, the class buttons at its right)
jobs.description: Pixel art, wide view of a crew's base camp in a British lay-by after a collapse: an old touring caravan with its awning out, a camping table with maps and a kettle, a punch bag hung from a lamp post, a row of jerry cans, a tarp shelter with a bench and a rack of training weights, a hatchback with its boot open, wet tarmac. Muted blue-grey palette, dark navy shadows, overcast evening light, one or two warm orange lamps. The left third and the bottom quarter stay darker and lower in detail (a face, the title and the figures sit there); the interest is in the centre-right. No people, no text, no readable signage or lettering.
